_note: v2.5 plan 07 A2 live gate, engine-off leg (LANE ONLY). Before the run: switch User Settings > experimental macro engine OFF on the lane, then node scripts/debug/st-session.mts reload (the bridge-registered per-key macros re-register into the engine active at startup). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/live-v25-07-a2-engine-off.json --sandbox --group <lane group id>. The macroArgs capability reads absent and names the fallback, {{story_quality::location}} stays literal, {{story_quality_location}} still resolves. Afterwards switch the engine back ON and reload; host.macroEngine is the one declared run-header difference of this leg.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.powerUserSettings?.experimental_macro_engine !== false) throw new Error('this leg needs the new macro engine switched off: switch experimental_macro_engine off and reload first'); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((name) => name.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; return { macroEngine: 'off' };

send_generate.text: We stay put for a moment.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const arg = ctx.substituteParams('{{story_quality::location}}'); const flat = ctx.substituteParams('{{story_quality_location}}'); const fail = []; if (arg !== '{{story_quality::location}}') fail.push(`the :: form resolved to ${arg} with the new engine off`); if (flat !== 'yard') fail.push(`the per-key form reads ${flat}, want yard`); if (fail.length) throw new Error(fail.join('; ')); return { arg, flat };

const recheck = [...document.querySelectorAll('#so-capabilities button')].find((button) => /recheck/i.test(button.textContent ?? '')); if (recheck) recheck.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)); const row = document.getElementById('so-capability-macroArgs'); if (!row) throw new Error('#so-capability-macroArgs is not shown: the capability did not read absent'); const text = row.textContent ?? ''; if (!text.includes('stays literal') || !text.includes('{{story_quality_key}} works everywhere')) throw new Error(`the capability row does not name the fallback: ${text}`); return text;
